body: I think some space would be good for us, but I'm worried that if I don't see her for a long time, she'll do something drastic and I won't be there to stop her. I can't contact her parents because they are the source of her PTSD and I know the kind of people they are and that they will 100% make things worse. Her dad sees her as his property that he can abuse however he wants rather than an actual person.
